Detected species, ready to choose examples

Source: R/species.R
detected_species.Rd

Summarises the detected species (like species_summary()) and prints a vector c("scientific name" = n, ...) ready to copy, change the n and paste into extract_examples(). The proposed n is the number of examples that meet the criteria of select_examples() (confidence of at least example_confidence, no doubts and one per recording), at most n_max. The same vector is returned (invisibly), so it can also be passed on directly: extract_examples(am, detected_species(am)).

Usage

detected_species(
  x,
  min_confidence = 0.5,
  example_confidence = 0.85,
  no_doubts = TRUE,
  n_max = 3,
  print = TRUE
)

Arguments

x

An audiomoth object with detections, a list of them (several recorders) or a data frame from read_detections().

min_confidence

Only detections with at least this confidence.

example_confidence, no_doubts

Criteria of the examples (those of select_examples()), used to count the example_candidates.

n_max

Largest number of examples proposed per species.

print

Print the vector.

Value

Invisibly, a named integer vector (species = number of examples) with the summary of species_summary() (plus the column n_proposed) as attribute "summary".

Details

With several recorders, n is the largest number of examples that one recorder can give, since extract_examples() works recorder by recorder.

BirdNET confidence is a score, not the probability that the identification is right: it helps to sort the detections, but only listening to the examples tells whether they are correct (see create_validation()).

Examples

d <- read_detections(system.file("extdata", "example", "birdnet_detections.csv",
                                 package = "AudiomothR"))
species <- detected_species(d, example_confidence = 0.5)
#> # Species with confidence >= 0.5. n = examples that meet the criteria
#> # (confidence >= 0.5, no doubts, one per recording), up to 3. Change the n and paste it
#> # into extract_examples(am, species).
#> species <- c(
#>   "Motacilla cinerea"       = 0,  # Gray Wagtail | 1 detection | confidence max. 0.82, mean 0.82
#>   "Cettia cetti"            = 1,  # Cetti's Warbler | 1 detection | confidence max. 0.82, mean 0.82
#>   "Troglodytes troglodytes" = 1   # Eurasian Wren | 1 detection | confidence max. 0.63, mean 0.63
#> )
attr(species, "summary")
#>           scientific_name     common_name detections days recordings
#> 1       Motacilla cinerea    Gray Wagtail          1    1          1
#> 2            Cettia cetti Cetti's Warbler          1    1          1
#> 3 Troglodytes troglodytes   Eurasian Wren          1    1          1
#>   confidence_max confidence_mean location_prob example_candidates n_proposed
#> 1         0.8222           0.822        0.2949                  0          0
#> 2         0.8196           0.820        0.5931                  1          1
#> 3         0.6319           0.632        0.2354                  1          1
